- Retention: operational logs kept 30 days; aggregated telemetry (non-PII) retained 12 months.

- Marissa (me): share our short data-handling summary and the customer opt-out form. (attached: redwood_data_handling_summary.pdf)

Thanks \u2014 I can also schedule a short follow-up with our Security/Privacy lead if Alyssa from Legal wants a walkthrough.
